Overview

Blockchain & Digital Trust for Energy & Utilities earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from SCADA / EMS cores and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. Energy & Utilities punishes generic deployments. grid state moves faster than batch cycles, NERC CIP standards demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Failure modes we design against, with the guard shipped for each:

items: On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
